system.description:
Myrgha Inheritance: a craft or ritual. Legendary[1], Salt. 1 item slot. Attunement. Special Property: Goldstore.

Prerequisites: You are a family member of the Myrgha Oligarchy, Proficiency[4]

A detailed and uniquely ornamental longsword made out of pure gold.

Goldweave Blade (Passive): This sword is treated as a Longsword. It overcomes all nonmagical damage resistances, and you gain +1 to all To-Hit and damage when using it. If you are a Goldbinder Fatebound, you can take Goldblade and Goldenhoard when you are attuned to this item.

Rulebook p.34.
